_evidence: Segment-record words read by 0x00427bc1 (edi = record 0..29 of the 0x160-byte ring at 0x8943a0; overlay after ring_008943a0+words_008943a0). Pit records (edi >= [0x891500]) average movsx +0x52/+0x54; otherwise, by the sign of eax, movsx +0x52 (eax < 0) or +0x54 is clamped to |x| >= 0x240 and divides 0x1000000 (edx = 0: |q| <= 0x71c7), then q -/+ (movzx +0x60/+0x62 + 0x50) - eax is clamped the same way and divides 0x1000000 (cdq). Both divisors are clamped away from 0, so no word value faults; the value lists put x on both sides of +-0x240 and of 0, and pair q = 0x1000000/x (0x1000 -> 0x1000, 0x4000 -> 0x400, ...) with lane words 0xfb0/0x3b0/0x1000 so that the second operand is within 0x240 of zero for the spec's eax in +-4096 (the |ebp| < 0x240 clamp blocks). 34 records (count 34) as words_008943a0.
